messages:
Ana (AE): Dataridge CTO just pinged me — urgent: BYO KMS requirement, VPC peering, 99.9% throughput SLA for POC, and a security questionnaire that mentions key rotation + egress certs. They want an exec-level answer today. Can we triage quickly?
Devon (SE): ack. Can you paste the exact KMS ask? Is it full BYO with HSM attestation or just customer-managed keys in cloud KMS?
Ana (AE): Quote from CTO: 'We require customer-managed keys (KMS) with HSM-backed encryption and an auditable attestation; no key material leaves our control.' They also want a short pricing sketch for reserved capacity (1x GPU pool) + trial credits.
Priya (Eng): HSM-backed BYO is doable on Private. For Hosted/Dedicated we'd need envelope encryption + customer KMS via external KMS integration. For the throughput SLA — do they mean sustained throughput (tokens/sec) or 99.9% request success under peak? Need clarification.
Ana (AE): I'll ask — quick: sustained throughput 5000 tok/sec per model, 99.9% success, <200ms p50 on short prompts.
Luca (Infra): For VPC peering we need customer ASN, allowed CIDR ranges, and egress IP list. Also will need us to open TLS termination and optionally support mTLS if they want mutual auth. Can we get those details before we promise peering timelines?
Grace (Legal): On BYO KMS: legal will need key custodian contract language + DPA addendum. Also, if they demand attestation, we need to know the format (certificate vs syslog evidence). Share the security questionnaire now and we'll start redlines.
Ana (AE): Sharing questionnaire PDF in thread: https://dataridge.example/sq-DR-2026.pdf. CTO expects answer by COB today.
Devon (SE): Skimming questionnaire — Q17 asks for key rotation windows and raw key export policy. Our short answer: rotation supported, keys never exported to Redwood-managed storage; integration supports Cloud KMS APIs.
Priya (Eng): Technical note: for <200ms p50 we might not hit that on large context lengths with current model. Suggest proposing a pinned smaller model variant or dedicated capacity with kernel optimizations. Will draft lat/cost tradeoff bullet.
Luca (Infra): Ops checklist snippet below for peering and KMS tunnel:
```
- Customer provides ASN, CIDR, allowed ports (443, 22 for mgmt optional)
- Exchange cert (PEM) for mTLS if requested
- Network contact + change window (2hr)
- Firewall rules: allow egress to 54.23.100.0/24 (redwood-egress)
- Route propagation via BGP or static routes
```
Devon (SE): Also adding model fallback plan: if dedicated pool capacity hits limit, auto-fallback to a smaller quantized variant in same region. We'll include cost delta.
Grace (Legal): We'll prepare a short addendum template and mark where we need customer signature for KMS custody. Can Ops/Infra hold off on peering until legal gets initial ack? We prefer aligned timeline.
Ana (AE): CTO specifically said 'we're green to sign if KMS + SLA approved today'. That's timeline pressure.
Priya (Eng): Proposed response: 1) We can support HSM-backed BYO on Private within 2-3 weeks (installation/attestation window). 2) For Dedicated we can support customer-managed keys via KMS integration within 5 business days, with attestation options (certificate exportable by customer). 3) For Hosted, recommend envelope encryption + customer KMS — full BYO not available on multi-tenant hosted. 4) Throughput: with dedicated GPU pool we can target 5k tok/s sustained p99 < 500ms, p50 ~200ms on short prompts. Need to caveat by model/context.
Luca (Infra): If we go Dedicated and need peering now, I can provision a provisional tunnel in 48 hours once we have CIDRs and certs. But legal signoff for KMS is a gating item for BYO.
Devon (SE): I'll prepare a 1-page POC tech plan + pricing: reserved capacity monthly cost + estimated delta if we add BYO KMS integration work.
OpsBot: @channel Reminder: For customer-data controls and encryption, follow the BYO-KMS runbook: /runbooks/byo-kms-v2. Required attachments: KMS key policy, attestation cert, network diagram.
Grace (Legal): Received questionnaire link — starting redlines. Likely change requests around attestation wording and liability for key compromise. ETA 6 hours.
Ana (AE): Action items summarized: Devon -> 1-pg POC tech & pricing (2h). Priya -> SLA/caveat bullets + suggested model variant (3h). Luca -> provisional peering checklist & timing (48h after CIDR). Grace -> legal redline (6h). I'll own exec sync and customer communication.
Devon (SE): Noted. Will include fallback quantized model and cost table.
Priya (Eng): Also flagging: if customer wants strict key isolation with hardware HSM on our infra, that's an on-prem/private engagement — we need to escalate to sales engineering for a deployment quote.
Ana (AE): Understood. Will surface that if they push for HSM-on-redwood.
Luca (Infra): One more ask: who will be on the exec call if CTO signs? Need Ops + Eng + Legal. I'll block time.
Grace (Legal): I'll join the call for any contract-level signoffs.
Ana (AE): Scheduled exec sync today 3:30pm PT. I'll send calendar invite to CTO, you all.
Devon (SE): Sending draft POC doc to thread in 45m.
Priya (Eng): Uploading latency/cost table shortly.
Ana (AE): Thank you team — current status: BLOCKERS = legal redline + customer CIDRs/cert for peering. Next update in 2 hours. :pray:
